briefdescription.para: List of peripheral blocks to reset.
Tests the reset controller driver by resetting peripheral blocks.

detaileddescription.para: The function tests the reset controller driver by resetting the peripheral blocks listed in PeriList[].
The function modifies the value of the peripheral register. It then resets the peripheral and validates the register value against the reset value of the register.

briefdescription.para: Demonstrates usage of the Reset Controller (ResetPs) driver.

detaileddescription.para: The example maintains a list of peripheral blocks to reset. Each list entry has a peripheral reset ID, a register address to modify, the value to write, and the value of that register after reset. The example writes the provided value to the register of each peripheral block. It then resets the peripheral and verifies the register value against the reset value.
